verdicts.reason: A breaks the phone-and-circle motif: the circle slides down behind the SOLSTICE/headline block, so the text sits on a stray shape. The phone is crammed against the top-left edge, and the CTA is jammed near the bottom edge. B keeps the phone and circle together, and the brand-headline-product order reads well. But B mixes a centred logo and phone with a left-aligned headline, its subcopy is tiny, and the two badges are scattered below the CTA with uneven gaps.
